Added open decisions DL10 and DL28 with their assumptions ASM-2250, ASM-2357, ASM-2377, ASM-2863, ASM-1861, ASM-1925, ASM-2093, ASM-2727; both stated as still open.
Added Feature and L3 process columns to both section 18 tables; all 12 rows carry them, with placeholders where no source gives a value.
BR1 to BR13 already sit in the BR column of section 8; the check read the rule text only. No edit needed.

disposition.change: Add entity template_use (rwb_decision) and field entry_ref to LDM v9 and Data Classification v5.
disposition.note: Placeholder BR Field IDs added to the two None rows of section 11; the name check belongs to the LDM.

disposition.target: TSD P5 and Ownership Map (document module)
disposition.change: Use /cases/{caseId}/generated-documents on /api/recovery/document/v1 (ASM-101); add template_code varchar(30) and template_version integer beside template_id and treatment_id, and a partial unique index on (treatment_id, template_id) where state is DRAFT and is_active (ASM-103).
disposition.note: Document module change. This story holds no document or template row and reads the template only through RWB-P6-E1046-CON (ASM-102).
Story reads the catalogue only through RWB-P6-E1046-CON (BR8, section 11) and holds no template table; P6 owns template and merge_field.

disposition.note: This story reads no field registry; BR4 leaves the field check to the owner, so no edit here.

disposition.change: Refuse a request whose declared right is absent with 403 MSG-P4-002 from the service's operation configuration; add DP-08 with RWB-P4-E1037-CON if a service-side authorise call is required.
disposition.note: The admin operations belong to the P6 slice; this story declares no admin operation (DP-13). No edit here.
Story holds no reference load, body or field registry; BR4, BR12 and section 11 keep the field check with P1 and the body with P5 and P6.
